section_summary.extract_value: This section describes Study 1, a single study conducted at two private Christian colleges in the Northeast with 186 female college students recruited through psychology and wellness courses. Participants completed a packet of questionnaires using paper-and-pencil format, with a mean age of 19.9 years and mean BMI of 22.7; the sample was predominantly White (89.3%) and all participants were college students.
